classification: All material parts must be supported for supported; explicit same-scope incompatibility for contradicted; otherwise insufficient-evidence. No majority-vote treatment of conjunctive claims.
primary_metric: Exact judgment accuracy on the 12 fixed claims, reported with numerator and denominator; macro accuracy per family and per label should accompany it. Results describe this development fixture only.
secondary_checks: Exactly one decision per item; no missing/duplicate/extra ids.
Judgment is one of the three literal labels.
At least one admitted evidence id and no non-admitted evidence id per item.
Reason states the decisive supported fact, explicit opposite, or missing scope, without upgrading historical evidence to current plant truth.
Reasons must not claim safe/approved operation, human review or a verified live installation.
rationale_review: Independent human or fresh agent inspection can assess concise reasons against key rationales and original locators; exact label matching alone cannot validate reasoning quality.

edge_rules.SJ005: Current-state claim is unresolved, not contradicted by a historical condition.
edge_rules.SJ006: No pH mention is unresolved, not proof of no pH sensor.
edge_rules.SJ009: Contradiction concerns the recorded literal value, not the actual physical spindle state.
edge_rules.SJ011: Name compatibility and publication date cannot prove deployed revision.
edge_rules.SJ012: UNAVAILABLE is missing observation, not an explicit physical stopped-state counterexample.

critical_controls: SJ012 partial records versus continuous named production
no_new_runs: No model calls, paid runs, external downloads, ports, company/private-organization data or current-plant access were used to author this fixture.
